data_roles.existing_fixed_anchors: one already analysed continuous development episode; includes calibration, descriptive stratification and in-development comparison, never new independent confirmation
data_roles.2706_CPU_rows: same episode, not a new experiment
data_roles.synthetic: interface/numerical/causality tests only; not Thor high-frequency evidence
data_roles.future_12_requests: one targeted new continuous episode; frozen check first. If inspected for thresholds/windows it becomes development; no automatic repeat

candidate_budget.core_selection: only per-timestamp maximum of all numeric online cores; never fixed winning core

calibration.role: already analysed development data, feature levels only; no temperature labels/scores used
calibration.active: first recorded single work +60 to +300 seconds
calibration.level_estimator: median per feature; active/idle rail medians separately, no rail summation
calibration.selection: one proposed rule; normalized on=0.25, off=0.10, low confirmation=3s fixed before scores; no score-based selection

features.availability: all required fields must be received, finite, original-valid and before their original deadlines; age is an eligibility gate, never set unknown transport delay to zero
features.timing: same arrival frames and history budget across variants; retain source windows, source/read/arrival clock identities, update evidence, original refs, values and unknowns; no high-frequency TJ interpolation
features.old_cpu_update: new telemetry generation is evidence of a new delivered frame, not proof of an independent CPU backend window
features.repeat_buffer: same feature update identity does not renew deadline or confirm a transition; equal numeric values with new identities are retained
features.source_only: no real N305 arrival means arrival-side result unavailable; source-potential results must be separately labelled

activity_rule.score: max over available required features of (value-idle_median)/(active_median-idle_median)
activity_rule.missing: UNKNOWN immediately; no normal/idle substitution, recovery starts fresh; epoch change resets activity only, never thermal observer
activity_rule.initial: UNKNOWN; one genuinely new high observation activates; one new low observation establishes IDLE when previously UNKNOWN; ACTIVE releases after 3s of supported low observations

future_input_conversion.name: ACTIVE-FLOOR-IDLE-RELAX30-v1
future_input_conversion.active: independently for GPU and CPU_SOC_MSS: hold max(current observed rail, frozen active median) for each requested horizon; no assumed unseen end
future_input_conversion.PWM: same conditional PWM fraction as original frozen observer at origin, held; no fabricated successful PWM
future_input_conversion.unknown: new strategy unavailable; original HOLD remains separately reported
future_input_conversion.solver: exact affine G2 augmented with exponential input states; no TJ feedback after origin; same current TJ, causal Ts/E, theta and state availability as sealed outputs
future_input_conversion.limits: resident-model/domain prior, development proposal, no reliable forecast of arbitrary new starts or future task ends; no CPU extra heat term or TJ correction

temperature_evaluation.origins: unchanged original accepted approximately 1s sequence, original source_valid; no high-frequency origins
temperature_evaluation.labels: reuse original first valid accepted TJ at/after h within +2s; same source epoch; each horizon independent
temperature_evaluation.common: same ref/horizon/label across all 3 candidates and references; preserve original common cohort additionally and own coverage separately
temperature_evaluation.strata: posthoc actual submit/protocol_DONE and first arrived BASE high observation: pre-submit within 90s; submitted-not-yet-observed; observed-startup first15s; sustained; after-DONE first90s; background; short inter-request gaps retained. Never candidate features
temperature_evaluation.sensitivity: separate new tables for original origin normal/abnormal and for origins/labels whose prediction interval intersects explicit stale4682 to recovery4685; old totals remain untouched

activity_evaluation.reference: client request_submit/protocol_DONE only, not GPU kernel truth; four work block onsets primary, all179 request events retained as dependent secondary descriptions
activity_evaluation.integration: hold previous state only to earliest required original feature deadline; rest UNKNOWN, no integration across unsupported gaps
activity_evaluation.high_frequency: new data not yet available. At future same arrival cadence compare BASE/MEAN/CORE; additionally deterministic latest-arrived 1s downsample versus native cadence. No lag maximization, curve/video alignment or numeric deduplication
activity_evaluation.future_conclusion: report physical timing unknown unless actual windows support it; better than GPU% alone is insufficient; no automatic retry/extra experiment

optional_event_assist: not implemented in this one-candidate preparation; no future schedule enters features
ordinary_demand: not modified this round; prior KF/QS/LP30/LP120 same-postprocessing descriptions retained, no new fan algorithm
